nodes.name: ChatQueryRequest.java
nodes.summary: Chat query request DTO: message, conversationId (optional), stream (boolean), attachments (list of file IDs). Validation for message length.

nodes.name: UpdateConversationTitleRequest.java
nodes.summary: Update conversation title request DTO: conversationId, title. Simple rename operation.

nodes.name: ChatQueryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Chat query response DTO: conversationId, messageId, content, citations (list of CitationResponse), tokensUsed, latencyMs, route. Non-streaming response wrapper.

nodes.name: CitationResponse.java
nodes.summary: Citation response DTO: documentId, documentName, snippet, relevanceScore, pageNumber, documentType. Source attribution for AI answers.

nodes.name: AiServiceClient.java
nodes.summary: AI service client: WebClient wrapper for ai-service API calls. Methods: chatQuery (streaming and non-streaming), getConversations, getConversationHistory, deleteConversation, updateTitle, uploadDocument. Handles SSE parsing, error mapping, and timeout.

nodes.name: AssetController.java
nodes.summary: Asset REST controller: endpoints for asset CRUD (getAssets, getAssetDetail, createAsset, updateAsset, deleteAsset), asset requests (createRequest, approveRequest, rejectRequest), assignments (assignAsset, returnAsset, getAssignments), maintenance (scheduleMaintenance, completeMaintenance), categories, images, inventory logs, and depreciation reports. Role-based access.

nodes.name: Asset.java
nodes.summary: Asset JPA entity: id, code, name, categoryId, status (AVAILABLE, ASSIGNED, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED, LOST), purchaseDate, purchasePrice, depreciationRate, currentValue, location, serialNumber, warrantyExpiry, specifications (JSON), notes, createdAt, updatedAt. Core asset record.

nodes.name: AssetAssignment.java
nodes.summary: AssetAssignment JPA entity: id, assetId, userId, assignedDate, returnedDate, status (ASSIGNED, RETURNED, OVERDUE), conditionOnAssign, conditionOnReturn, notes. Tracks asset custody chain.

nodes.name: AssetCategory.java
nodes.summary: AssetCategory JPA entity: id, name, code, description, defaultDepreciationRate, parentCategoryId (self-ref for hierarchy), isActive. Category tree for asset classification.

nodes.name: AssetImage.java
nodes.summary: AssetImage JPA entity: id, assetId, imageUrl, isPrimary, caption, uploadedBy, uploadedAt. Multiple images per asset with primary flag.

nodes.name: AssetInventoryLog.java
nodes.summary: AssetInventoryLog JPA entity: id, assetId, action (CREATED, UPDATED, ASSIGNED, RETURNED, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED), performedBy, performedAt, details (JSON). Audit trail for asset lifecycle.

nodes.name: AssetMaintenance.java
nodes.summary: AssetMaintenance JPA entity: id, assetId, maintenanceType (PREVENTIVE, CORRECTIVE, CALIBRATION), scheduledDate, completedDate, status (SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED), cost, vendor, description, performedBy. Maintenance tracking.

nodes.name: AssetRequest.java
nodes.summary: AssetRequest JPA entity: id, userId, categoryId, requestedAssetId (optional), quantity, reason, urgency, status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, FULFILLED), approverId, approvedAt, createdAt. Asset procurement requests.

nodes.name: AssetErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: AssetErrorCode enum: ASSET_NOT_FOUND, ASSET_ALREADY_ASSIGNED, ASSET_NOT_ASSIGNED, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, MAINTENANCE_OVERDUE, DEPRECIATION_CALCULATION_ERROR. Used by AssetException.

nodes.name: AssetRequestStatus.java
nodes.summary: AssetRequestStatus enum: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, FULFILLED. Asset request workflow states.

nodes.name: AssetStatus.java
nodes.summary: AssetStatus enum: AVAILABLE, ASSIGNED, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED, LOST. Asset lifecycle states.

nodes.name: AssignmentStatus.java
nodes.summary: AssignmentStatus enum: ASSIGNED, RETURNED, OVERDUE. Assignment custody states.

nodes.name: MaintenanceStatus.java
nodes.summary: MaintenanceStatus enum: SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED. Maintenance workflow states.

nodes.name: MaintenanceType.java
nodes.summary: MaintenanceType enum: PREVENTIVE, CORRECTIVE, CALIBRATION. Maintenance classification for scheduling and reporting.

nodes.name: AssetException.java
nodes.summary: Asset exception: extends RuntimeException with AssetErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: AssetAssignmentRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetAssignment repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findByUserIdAndStatus, findOverdueAssignments, findByDateRange. Used for assignment tracking and overdue alerts.

nodes.name: AssetCategoryRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetCategory repository: JPA repository with findByCode, findByParentCategoryId, findActiveCategories, findTree. Supports category hierarchy traversal.

nodes.name: AssetImageRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetImage repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findPrimaryByAssetId. Image management per asset.

nodes.name: AssetInventoryLogRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetInventoryLog repository: JPA repository with findByAssetIdOrderByPerformedAtDesc, findByAction, findByDateRange, findByPerformedBy. Audit trail queries.

nodes.name: AssetMaintenanceRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetMaintenance repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findByStatus, findOverdueMaintenance, findByScheduledDateBetween, findByMaintenanceType. Maintenance scheduling and tracking.

nodes.name: AssetRepository.java
nodes.summary: Asset repository: JPA repository with findByCode, findByCategoryId, findByStatus, findByAssignedUserId, searchByNameOrCode, findAssetsNeedingMaintenance, findAssetsNearWarrantyExpiry. Core asset queries.

nodes.name: AssetRequestRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetRequest repository: JPA repository with findByUserId, findByStatus, findByCategoryId, findPendingRequests, findByDateRange. Request tracking and approval workflow.

nodes.name: AssetCategorySeeder.java
nodes.summary: Asset category seeder: CommandLineRunner that populates default asset categories (Laptop, Monitor, Phone, Furniture, Vehicle, Software License, Peripheral) on application startup if empty.

nodes.name: AssetService.java
nodes.summary: Asset service: core business logic for asset lifecycle (create, update, delete, assign, return, maintenance, depreciation calculation, inventory logging). Integrates with FileStorageService for images, AssetRepository, AssetAssignmentRepository, AssetCategoryRepository, AssetImageRepository, AssetInventoryLogRepository, AssetMaintenanceRepository, AssetRequestRepository.

nodes.name: DashboardController.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard REST controller: endpoints for getSummary (role-based: admin/hr sees company stats, manager sees team stats, staff sees personal stats), getAttendanceTrends, getLeaveBalance, getUpcomingEvents, getNotifications. Aggregates data from multiple services.

nodes.name: DashboardSummaryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard summary response DTO: role-specific fields. Admin/HR: totalEmployees, pendingLeaves, pendingOvertime, pendingAssets, activeTickets, payrollStatus. Manager: teamSize, teamPendingLeaves, teamPendingOvertime, teamAttendanceRate. Staff: myAttendanceStatus, myLeaveBalance, myPendingRequests, myUpcomingShifts.

nodes.name: DashboardService.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard service: aggregates data from UserProfileRepository, AttendanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository, OvertimeRecordRepository, AssetRequestRepository, ItTicketRepository, PayrollRepository. Builds role-specific summary. Uses SpecificationScopes for dynamic filtering.

nodes.name: DocumentController.java
nodes.summary: Document REST controller: endpoints for uploadDocument, getDocuments (paginated, filtered), getDocumentDetail, downloadDocument, deleteDocument, updateDocumentMetadata, getDocumentCategories. Integrates with ai-service for indexing via DocumentService.

nodes.name: UpsertDocumentRequest.java
nodes.summary: Upsert document request DTO: documentId (optional for update), title, category, tags, description, file (MultipartFile). Validation for file type/size and required fields.

nodes.name: DocumentResponse.java
nodes.summary: Document response DTO: documentId, title, category, tags, description, fileUrl, fileType, fileSize, uploadedBy, uploadedAt, indexedAt, indexStatus. Metadata for document listing and detail.

nodes.name: Document.java
nodes.summary: Document JPA entity: id, title, category, tags (JSON array), description, filePath, fileType, fileSize, minioBucket, minioObjectKey, uploadedBy, uploadedAt, indexedAt, indexStatus (PENDING, INDEXED, FAILED), indexError. Links to MinIO storage and ai-service indexing.

nodes.name: DocumentCategory.java
nodes.summary: DocumentCategory enum: POLICY, CONTRACT, HANDBOOK, FORM, REPORT, TEMPLATE, LEGAL, TRAINING, OTHER. Classification for document organization and retrieval filtering.

nodes.name: DocumentErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: DocumentErrorCode enum: DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_FILE_TYPE, FILE_TOO_LARGE, UPLOAD_FAILED, DELETE_FAILED, INDEXING_FAILED, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED. Used by DocumentException.

nodes.name: DocumentFileType.java
nodes.summary: DocumentFileType enum: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG. Allowed file types for upload validation.

nodes.name: DocumentException.java
nodes.summary: Document exception: extends RuntimeException with DocumentErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: DocumentRepository.java
nodes.summary: Document repository: JPA repository with findByCategory, findByUploadedBy, findByIndexStatus, searchByTitleOrTags, findByDateRange, findPendingIndexing. Supports pagination and sorting.

nodes.name: DocumentService.java
nodes.summary: Document service: handles upload (MinIO via FileStorageService), metadata management, deletion, and triggers ai-service indexing via async call. Manages index status lifecycle (PENDING -> INDEXED/FAILED).

nodes.name: ItTicketController.java
nodes.summary: IT Ticket REST controller: endpoints for createTicket, getTickets (paginated, filtered by status/category/priority/assignee), getTicketDetail, addComment, updateStatus, assignTicket, escalateTicket, getSLAStatus, exportTickets. Role-based: staff creates/views own, IT staff views all, admin manages.

nodes.name: ItTicket.java
nodes.summary: ItTicket JPA entity: id, ticketNumber (auto-generated), title, description, category, priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL), status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_USER, RESOLVED, CLOSED), requesterId, assigneeId, createdAt, updatedAt, resolvedAt, closedAt, slaDeadline, satisfactionRating. Core ticket record with SLA tracking.

nodes.name: ItTicketCategory.java
nodes.summary: ItTicketCategory enum: HARDWARE, SOFTWARE, NETWORK, ACCESS, EMAIL, SECURITY, OTHER. Classification for routing and reporting.

nodes.name: ItTicketErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: ItTicketErrorCode enum: TICKET_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, UNASSIGNED_TICKET, SLA_BREACH, COMMENT_NOT_ALLOWED, PERMISSION_DENIED, INVALID_PRIORITY, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND. Used by ItTicketException.

nodes.name: ItTicketPriority.java
nodes.summary: ItTicketPriority enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL. Determines SLA response/resolution times.

nodes.name: ItTicketStatus.java
nodes.summary: ItTicketStatus enum: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_USER, RESOLVED, CLOSED. Ticket workflow states with valid transitions.

nodes.name: ItTicketException.java
nodes.summary: ItTicket exception: extends RuntimeException with ItTicketErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: ItTicketRepository.java
nodes.summary: ItTicket repository: JPA repository with findByRequesterId, findByAssigneeId, findByStatus, findByCategory, findByPriority, findSlaBreached, findByDateRange, searchByTitleOrDescription. Supports pagination and SLA monitoring.

nodes.name: ItTicketService.java
nodes.summary: IT Ticket service: business logic for ticket lifecycle (create, update, assign, escalate, resolve, close), comment management, SLA calculation and monitoring, auto-escalation on breach, satisfaction survey. Integrates with ItTicketRepository, UserProfileRepository for assignee lookup.

nodes.name: PerformanceController.java
nodes.summary: Performance REST controller: endpoints for review cycles (getCycles, createCycle, updateCycle, closeCycle), self-reviews (submitSelfReview, getMyReviews), manager reviews (getTeamReviews, submitManagerReview), calibration (calibrateScores, getScoreDistribution), export. Role-based access.

nodes.name: ManagerScoreRequest.java
nodes.summary: Manager score request DTO: reviewId, revieweeId, scores (map of competencyId to score), comments, overallRating. Manager evaluation submission.

nodes.name: PerformanceFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Performance filter request DTO: cycleId, userId, departmentId, status, revieweeId, page, size, sortBy, sortDir. Paginated review queries.

nodes.name: ScoreItemRequest.java
nodes.summary: Score item request DTO: competencyId, score (1-5), comment. Individual competency scoring.

nodes.name: SelfSubmitRequest.java
nodes.summary: Self submit request DTO: reviewId, scores (map of competencyId to score), achievements, goals, developmentNeeds. Employee self-evaluation.

nodes.name: PerformanceOverviewResponse.java
nodes.summary: Performance overview response DTO: cycleId, cycleName, startDate, endDate, status, totalReviews, completedReviews, averageScore, scoreDistribution (buckets), departmentBreakdown. Cycle-level summary.

nodes.name: PerformanceReviewResponse.java
nodes.summary: Performance review response DTO: reviewId, revieweeId, revieweeName, cycleId, status, selfScores, managerScores, calibratedScores, overallRating, submittedAt, calibratedAt. Individual review detail.

nodes.name: PerformanceReview.java
nodes.summary: PerformanceReview JPA entity: id, cycleId, revieweeId, reviewerId (manager), status (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, MANAGER_REVIEWED, CALIBRATED, FINALIZED), selfScores (JSON), managerScores (JSON), calibratedScores (JSON), overallRating, submittedAt, managerReviewedAt, calibratedAt, finalizedAt. Multi-stage review with calibration.

nodes.name: PerformanceScore.java
nodes.summary: PerformanceScore JPA entity: id, reviewId, competencyId, score, comment, scoredBy (SELF, MANAGER, CALIBRATED), scoredAt. Granular score tracking per competency per review stage.

nodes.name: PerformanceErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: PerformanceErrorCode enum: REVIEW_NOT_FOUND, CYCLE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, REVIEW_ALREADY_SUBMITTED, CYCLE_CLOSED, INVALID_SCORE_RANGE, CALIBRATION_FAILED, PERMISSION_DENIED. Used by PerformanceException.

nodes.name: PeriodType.java
nodes.summary: PeriodType enum: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMI_ANNUAL, ANNUAL. Review cycle frequency.

nodes.name: ReviewStatus.java
nodes.summary: ReviewStatus enum: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, MANAGER_REVIEWED, CALIBRATED, FINALIZED. Multi-stage review workflow.

nodes.name: PerformanceException.java
nodes.summary: Performance exception: extends RuntimeException with PerformanceErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: PerformanceReviewRepository.java
nodes.summary: PerformanceReview repository: JPA repository with findByCycleId, findByRevieweeId, findByReviewerId, findByStatus, findByCycleIdAndStatus, findPendingCalibration. Supports calibration workflow queries.

nodes.name: PerformanceScoreRepository.java
nodes.summary: PerformanceScore repository: JPA repository with findByReviewId, findByCompetencyId, findByScoredBy, findAverageScoreByCompetency. Statistical queries for score distribution.

nodes.name: PerformanceService.java
nodes.summary: Performance service: core logic for review cycles (create, update, close), self/manager review submission, calibration (score normalization, forced distribution), score distribution calculation, export to Excel/CSV. Integrates with PerformanceReviewRepository, PerformanceScoreRepository, UserProfileRepository, PerformanceSpecification.

nodes.name: PerformanceSpecification.java
nodes.summary: Performance JPA specifications: reusable predicates for review filtering (byCycleId, byRevieweeId, byReviewerId, byStatus, byDepartmentId, byDateRange, searchText). Composable with SpecificationScopes for dynamic queries.

nodes.name: PermissionGrant.java
nodes.summary: PermissionGrant JPA entity: id, userId, permissionKey (PermissionKey enum), granted (boolean), grantedBy, grantedAt, expiresAt (optional). Granular per-user permission overrides beyond role-based defaults.

nodes.name: PermissionKey.java
nodes.summary: PermissionKey enum: comprehensive list of granular permissions (e.g., EMPLOYEE_VIEW, EMPLOYEE_CREATE, EMPLOYEE_EDIT, EMPLOYEE_DELETE, LEAVE_APPROVE, LEEVE_VIEW_TEAM, PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT, ASSET_ASSIGN, TICKET_ASSIGN, REPORT_VIEW, ADMIN_USERS, ADMIN_PERMISSIONS). Maps to frontend feature flags.

nodes.name: PermissionGrantRepository.java
nodes.summary: PermissionGrant repository: JPA repository with findByUserId, findByUserIdAndPermissionKey, findEffectivePermissions (combines role defaults with grants). Used by auth filter for authorization.

nodes.name: PermissionBackfillRunner.java
nodes.summary: Permission backfill runner: CommandLineRunner that syncs default role permissions to PermissionGrant table on startup. Ensures new permissions are available for existing users.

nodes.name: PermissionService.java
nodes.summary: Permission service: manages permission grants (grant, revoke, bulkUpdate), computes effective permissions (role defaults + explicit grants), checks hasPermission(userId, permissionKey). Used by AdminService, JwtAuthFilter, and controllers for authorization.

nodes.name: ResignationController.java
nodes.summary: Resignation REST controller: endpoints for submitResignation, getMyResignation, getResignationDetail, withdrawResignation, approveResignation (manager), rejectResignation (manager), hrApprove (HR), hrReject (HR), scheduleExitInterview, submitHandoverPlan, getFinalSettlement, uploadOffboardingDoc. Multi-stage approval workflow.

nodes.name: ApproveResignationRequest.java
nodes.summary: Approve resignation request DTO: resignationId, approvedLastDay, comment. Manager/HR approval with last working day confirmation.

nodes.name: CreateResignationRequest.java
nodes.summary: Create resignation request DTO: requestedLastDay, reason, noticePeriodDays. Employee resignation submission with notice period.

nodes.name: TransferRequest.java
nodes.summary: Transfer request DTO: resignationId, handoverToUserId, handoverDetails, documents (list of doc IDs). Knowledge transfer during offboarding.

nodes.name: ResignationResponse.java
nodes.summary: Resignation response DTO: resignationId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, requestedLastDay, approvedLastDay, status, reason, noticePeriodDays, exitInterviewDate, handoverStatus, finalSettlementStatus, createdAt, updatedAt. Full lifecycle view.

nodes.name: ResignationRequest.java
nodes.summary: ResignationRequest JPA entity: id, userId, requestedLastDay, approvedLastDay, status (SUBMITTED, MANAGER_APPROVED, MANAGER_REJECTED, HR_APPROVED, HR_REJECTED, WITHDRAWN, COMPLETED), reason, noticePeriodDays, managerId, managerApprovedAt, hrId, hrApprovedAt, exitInterviewDate, handoverToUserId, handoverDetails, finalSettlementAmount, finalSettlementStatus, offboardingDocs (JSON). Complete offboarding tracker.

nodes.name: ResignationErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: ResignationErrorCode enum: RESIGNATION_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, RESIGNATION_ALREADY_PROCESSED, INVALID_NOTICE_PERIOD, WITHDRAWAL_NOT_ALLOWED, HANDOVER_REQUIRED, SETTLEMENT_PENDING, PERMISSION_DENIED. Used by ResignationException.

nodes.name: ResignationStatus.java
nodes.summary: ResignationStatus enum: SUBMITTED, MANAGER_APPROVED, MANAGER_REJECTED, HR_APPROVED, HR_REJECTED, WITHDRAWN, COMPLETED. Multi-stage approval workflow with withdrawal option.

nodes.name: ResignationException.java
nodes.summary: Resignation exception: extends RuntimeException with ResignationErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: ResignationRequestRepository.java
nodes.summary: ResignationRequest repository: JPA repository with findByUserId, findByStatus, findByManagerId, findByHrId, findPendingApprovals, findByDateRange. Supports approval workflow queries.

nodes.name: ResignationScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Resignation scheduler: @Scheduled job that checks for upcoming last days (sends reminders), overdue handovers, pending exit interviews, and auto-completes resignations past final settlement. Runs daily.

nodes.name: ResignationService.java
nodes.summary: Resignation service: core logic for resignation lifecycle (submit, approve/reject at each stage, withdraw, schedule exit interview, handover management, final settlement calculation, offboarding document tracking). Integrates with ResignationRequestRepository, UserProfileRepository, AssetAssignmentRepository (asset return), FileStorageService.
